constraints: Has no effect in project databases opened in single-user mode.
Resets any alias set for the current user via SET USER ALIAS.
If called with no parameters, displays the database connection dialog box instead of switching programmatically.
If the given user account does not exist or was deleted, error -9979 is returned (interceptible via ON ERR CALL).

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Switches the identity of the current database user, either interactively (dialog box, if called without parameters) or programmatically by name/ID and password, discarding the previous user's access privileges.
